## Skillerr 0.1.6

**Your Orb: your own AI model**
- The Orb is yours: a small AI model that lives in Skillerr on your computer. Nothing it learns is sent to Skillerr or
  anyone else.
- **Bring your Chrome tabs over, sorted into journeys.** ⋮ → Trails → bring your open Chrome tabs: the Orb groups them
  by the sitting you opened them in and what they're about, with their real icons. Nothing reloads, and nothing closes
  in Chrome.
- Benchmarked against all-MiniLM-L6-v2, the transformer it learned from: 7.9 MB, about 8 µs to read a page title on
  one CPU core, over 250× faster, with 98% of its accuracy at sorting tabs into journeys (docs/orb.md).

**Watch your AI's research, and keep it**
- **One live view per chat** in Claude Desktop: only the pages this AI opened in this research, never your own tabs.
  Older views fold into one line.
- **Audit**: every page it opened, read or tried to open, and why one failed. Click any to open it in Skillerr.
- **Your AIs' research sits right of the address bar**, and your trails left of it; the address bar stays centred.
  Research an AI has finished is put away there after a minute and a half, with its sources a click away. When a side
  gets crowded, it folds into one box that opens a list.
- Every AI app shows as itself, with its own mark.

**Research from real pages**
- AI searches get plain web results: no AI Overviews to answer from instead of the pages themselves.
- **Deep research** is in Settings: Off, or 1 to 5 links deep (3 when on). It applies to connected AI apps too.
- No empty live view is shown before a search has anything to show.

**Also**
- Site icons are kept on your computer, so trails and history show them without reloading pages.
- History, Bookmarks and Clear browsing data are each one clear place; Clear browsing data opens at the top of History.
- Without a built-in AI set up, Skillerr says your AI apps drive it, or that you can connect a local model (Ollama or
  LM Studio). No task box that can't run.
- Fixed: `read_tabs` without tab ids could read tabs another AI app was researching in. It now reads your tabs and the
  calling AI's own.
- Fixed: the research list opened from a crowded shelf could run past the edge of the window and hide its buttons.

**Install:** `curl -fsSL https://skillerr.com/install.sh | sh` (macOS, Linux) or `irm https://skillerr.com/install.ps1 | iex`
(Windows). Installed copies on Windows, the Linux AppImage and signed Mac builds update themselves.
